prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
System: Regional Dispatch Center (RDC; call sign Juniper) provides 24/7 EMS intake, pediatric/adult triage support, ambulance dispatch/coordination, surge declaration, mutual-aid coordination and regional coverage picture under approved protocols; jurisdictions retain ownership/local policy. Call Taker Mara records caller reports and pediatric age/weight/caregiver observations; verifies Bedside Arrival Receipt timeline/comms; if crew contact fails keeps caller connected when feasible while dispatch tries/logs approved alternate channels. Computer Aided Dispatch Console checks locations; displays incident/priority/travel/availability/access/staging/surge/facility constraints and latest confirmed unit status; is scenario-tested before regional release. Ambulance Coordination Platform consolidates timestamped unit position/status, matches units/destinations/instructions, distinguishes mutual-aid/local staffed resources, preserves queued updates, flags reconciliation; changes need operational/clinical/security/continuity assessment; monitored for availability, response time, data integrity, interface failures. Radio Coordinator Mistral uses Regional Radio Network/talkgroups to send assignments/hazards/routes/destinations/coverage/mutual-aid; requires repeat-back/ack, retries/alerts, fallback/change cards; uses South Access Lane Notice in accountable review. Regional Radio Network/interfaces are checked after maintenance/configuration changes. Crews acknowledge/repeat critical instructions; Paramedic Crew/Ambulance Unit 417 reports status/location/conflicts/hazards/delays/staging/arrival/handover, pediatric changes, restored-contact position/safe status; shall not enter uncertain area if instructions unconfirmed. Fleet Maintenance Cell Bluejay reports unavailable/restricted vehicles, Battery Swap Voucher, radio faults; uses Mutual Aid Release Form; schedules preventive work by manufacturer guidance/service history/regional requirements; records asset/work/parts/return-to-service; unavailable units excluded. Hospital Liaison Desk Kestrel records facility capacity/contact/constraints/responses, ED consults, restrictions, Bedside Arrival Receipt, Pediatric Acuity Note; confirms pediatric limits; contributes review observations while protecting unnecessary information. Regional Medical Director Copperfield approves temporary triage/protocol guidance changes and reviews significant clinical events. Triage Supervisor reviews acuity/escalation-risk cases/audit memo. Shift Commander may restrict operational capability for unresolved unacceptable-risk defects; RDC records rationale/scope/duration. Audit findings identify records/criteria/limitations; evidence retained with access/retention controls; material findings assigned owner/due date/closure verification. Release approvals identify owner/test evidence/limitations/rollback. Service/performance reviews

New part:
S247: The Regional Dispatch Center provides a periodic summary of assurance activities, open risks, and improvement progress to regional oversight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
